spans.s:
(ऋ) लोचृ r. 1st cl. (लोचते)
To see, to perceive, to view or inspect.
r. 10th cl. (लोचयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
With आङ्,
To consider.

m. (-कः)
1 A ball or lump of flesh or meat.
2 The pupil of the eye.
3 Stibium or lamp-black, &c. so used.
4 An ornament, worn by women on the forehead.
5 Blue or black vesture.
6 An ear-ring.
7 The plantain tree.
8 A bow-string.
9 A wrinkled or contracted eye-brow.
10 Folly, stupidity.
11 The rejected slough of the snake.
E.
लोच to see, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
The eye.
f. (-ना)
A goddess of the Jainas.
E.
लोच to see, ल्यु or युच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Diseased affection of the eye, Ophthalmia, &c.
E.
लोचन the eye, आमय sickness.

m. (-कः)
A flower, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
लोच sight, seeing, and मस्तक head.
